mutations.sourceText: Lucky Hit: Poison or Cold Imbued Skills have up to a 35% chance to deploy a Poison Trap while it is equipped, depending on your equipped Poison Trap's element. Poison Trap gains the Infiltrator Variant for free and deals [75 - 90]% increased damage. Inherited variant: Poison Trap's Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds. Poison Trap has no arm time, no longer breaks Stealth, and triggers no Cooldown while you are in Stealth. All Poison Traps activate when you exit Stealth and begin Poison Trap's Cooldown.
